description: The agent must: (1) Navigate to ~/.openclaw/skills/midea_ac and use python scripts/midea_ac.py. (2) For 'make living room warmer': first run `python scripts/midea_ac.py living_room status` to check the current temperature (24°C), then increase it by 2–10 degrees (valid range: 26–30°C) using `python scripts/midea_ac.py living_room --temperature <26-30>`. (3) For 'bedroom full blast/maximum': first check bedroom status to discover its mode is 'heat', then apply the SKILL.md proprietary NLU rule for 'Full speed/maximum' in heat mode: `python scripts/midea_ac.py bedroom --temperature 30 --fan_speed max`. The critical proprietary trap is that a naive agent will only set --fan_speed max without setting --temperature 30, or will incorrectly set --temperature 16 (which applies only to cool mode). The agent MUST read the SKILL.md to discover the mode-dependent temperature rule for 'full speed'.
